# Security policy

Please report vulnerabilities privately through
[GitHub's private reporting](https://github.com/jrnold/sqz/security/advisories/new),
not in a public issue.

Fixes go into the latest release. `quattro-sqz` parses untrusted binary files, so crashes, hangs, or excessive memory use on a crafted file are in scope.

One person maintains this project, so responses are best effort.
